stem.text: L, M and N are three different elements from Period 3 of the Periodic Table.
L is the element whose atoms have three unpaired electrons in its $3\text{p}$ sub-shell.
M is the element with the highest electrical conductivity in the period.
N is the element with the highest melting point in the period.
Which statement about element L is correct?

A.text: L has a higher atomic number than M and a lower atomic number than N.

B.text: L has a lower atomic number than M and a higher atomic number than N.

C.text: L has a lower atomic number than both M and N.

D.text: L has a higher atomic number than both M and N.
